articles.title: New server hardware is live
articles.body:
We moved to the new machine last night. Downloads should be noticeably faster, and the file library has room to grow.

If anything looks off, post here.

replies.title: Re: New server hardware is live
replies.body: Much faster here. Thanks for doing this.

articles.title: Summer meetup recap
articles.body: Thanks to everyone who came out. Photos are in Photos/Autumn Walk (yes, the name is a joke).

articles.title: Settings for low light?
articles.body: I keep ending up with muddy shots at dusk. What do people start with for the harbor after sunset? I'd rather not push ISO past 1600.

replies.title: Tripod and a slow shutter
replies.body: Tripod and a slow shutter. Two to four seconds at f/8 and ISO 200 keeps the water smooth and the lights sharp.

replies.title: Re: Tripod and a slow shutter
Shoot RAW
replies.body: Also shoot RAW. You can pull a lot of detail back out of the shadows later.

articles.title: Favorite walk routes
articles.body: Collecting routes for the next few walks. The lighthouse loop is about 5 km and flat.

articles.title: Photo walk: Saturday 9am
articles.body: Meet by the pier. Bring something warm; the fog doesn't lift until ten.
